title: Areca catechu L. procyanidins alleviate pulmonary fibrosis by suppressing the TGF-beta/Smad/ERK cascade: Validation of a traditional herbal medicine.
authors: Liu, Bin; Zhao, Yueru; Zhu, Mengxia; Liu, Lei
one_liner_zh: 该文研究槟榔原花青素通过TGF-beta/Smad/ERK通路缓解肺纤维化，虽含分子对接但对象为蛋白-小分子，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Areca nut has long been prescribed in Traditional Chinese Medicine for respiratory disorders resembling pulmonary fibrosis (PF). Its classical effects of resolving phlegm and dissipating chest stagnation, documented in Shennong Bencao Jing, align closely with PF's hallmark pathologies of interstitial scarring and excessive collagen accumulation, yet the mechanistic basis for its anti-fibrotic activity remains unelucidated. AIM OF THE STUDY: This study validated the anti-PF efficacy of areca nut procyanidins (ANP) and elucidated their multi-target mechanisms. MATERIALS AND METHODS: A multi-faceted approach integrating network pharmacology, molecular docking, and in vivo/vitro experiments was employed. Rat PF models induced by bleomycin were treated with ANP (1, 5, 15 mg/kg) for 28 days. LPS-stimulated 3T6 fibroblasts were used to evaluate cellular mechanisms. RESULTS: Network pharmacology predicted 72 common targets, with enrichment in the TGF-beta and MAPK pathways. Molecular docking confirmed strong binding affinity of ANP to TGF-beta1 (-8.8 kcal/mol) and Smad3 (-6.8 kcal/mol). In vivo, medium- and high-dose ANP significantly ameliorated lung histopathology, reduced collagen deposition (HYP), and restored antioxidant biomarkers (T-AOC, MPO, GSH). Mechanistically, ANP concurrently suppressed the TGF-beta/Smad/ERK signaling cascade, characterized by the downregulation of TGF-beta1, p-Smad3/4, and p-ERK, alongside the restoration of the inhibitory Smad7. In vitro, ANP inhibited fibroblast migration, inflammation (IL-1beta, TNF-alpha), and extracellular matrix production. CONCLUSION: By multi-target inhibition of the TGF-beta/Smad/ERK cascade, ANP ameliorates PF, consistent with areca nut's traditional phlegm-resolving and nodule-dissipating properties. Compared with pirfenidone, ANP exhibits superior safety and multi-pathway activity, rendering it a promising botanical therapeutic agent for PF.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：槟榔在中医中长期以来被用于治疗类似肺纤维化（PF）的呼吸系统疾病。其经典功效——化痰和消散胸中积滞，记载于《神农本草经》，与PF的间质瘢痕形成和过量胶原蛋白积累等标志性病理特征高度吻合，但其抗纤维化活性的机制基础尚未阐明。研究目的：本研究验证了槟榔原花青素（ANP）的抗PF功效，并阐明了其多靶点机制。材料与方法：采用整合网络药理学、分子对接及体内/体外实验的多方面方法。以博来霉素诱导的大鼠PF模型，给予ANP（1、5、15 mg/kg）治疗28天。使用脂多糖（LPS）刺激的3T6成纤维细胞评估细胞机制。结果：网络药理学预测了72个共同靶点，富集于TGF-beta和MAPK通路。分子对接确认ANP与TGF-beta1（-8.8 kcal/mol）和Smad3（-6.8 kcal/mol）具有强结合亲和力。体内实验中，中剂量和高剂量ANP显著改善肺组织病理学，减少胶原沉积（HYP），并恢复抗氧化生物标志物（T-AOC、MPO、GSH）。机制上，ANP同时抑制TGF-beta/Smad/ERK信号级联，表现为TGF-beta1、p-Smad3/4和p-ERK的下调，以及抑制性Smad7的恢复。体外实验中，ANP抑制成纤维细胞迁移、炎症（IL-1beta、TNF-alpha）和细胞外基质产生。结论：通过多靶点抑制TGF-beta/Smad/ERK级联，ANP改善PF，这与槟榔传统的化痰和散结特性一致。与吡非尼酮相比，ANP表现出更优的安全性和多通路活性，使其成为PF的一种有前景的植物治疗剂。
